title: A flipped classroom with whiteboard animation and modules to enhance students' self-regulation, critical thinking and communication skills: a conceptual framework and its implementation
reason: Re-extraction (inclusion not re-decided). Three-group quasi-experiment: MANCOVA treatment effects on self-reported self-regulation, critical-thinking and communication scores. Engagement with animation/modules is the treatment, never a measured per-student indicator. Would fail I1-I4 (E4/NOREL); flagged.

extraction.design: mixed methods: conceptual framework + quasi-experiment, non-equivalent control group (3 groups), MANCOVA
extraction.n_quote: The research participants in the implementation phase comprised 83 students divided into three classes.
extraction.population: in-service elementary school teachers enrolled in the undergraduate Elementary School Teacher Education (RPL) programme, course PDGK4202, open university
extraction.lms_indicators: none measured; worksheets uploaded to the LMS (silayar.ut.ac.id) are documented qualitatively only
extraction.notes: Only treatment F-values are reported, e.g. 'a significant effect of the different Tuweb models on the self-regulation variable (Y1), with an F-value of 45.673'; CT F = 98.322; communication F = 29.787; no partial eta2. These are group contrasts, not indicator-outcome relations, so none is extracted. Table 2 cells: country Indonesia and design confirmed; n = 83 now recoverable; LMS-side indicator cell ('Engagement with animation and modules') describes the intervention, not a measure.
